title: Genealogy of the Priests and Levites

questions.question: Who were the three sons of Levi?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:1 (ESV): "The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari."

questions.question: Who were the children of Amram?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:3 (ESV): "The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam."

questions.question: Who served as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:10 (ESV): "...and Azariah... it was he who served as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who was the father of Samuel the prophet?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:27-28 (ESV): "Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son. The sons of Samuel: Joel his firstborn, the second Abijah."

questions.question: Which son of Aaron was the father of Phinehas?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:4 (ESV): "Eleazar fathered Phinehas, Phinehas fathered Abishua..."

questions.question: Who was Heman the singer?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:33 (ESV): "...Heman the singer the son of Joel, son of Samuel..."

questions.question: Who was Asaph's ancestor?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:39, 43 (ESV): "...Asaph... son of Gershom, son of Levi."

questions.question: What was the specific duty of Aaron and his sons?
options: To make offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense
questions.correctAnswer: To make offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:49 (ESV): "But Aaron and his sons made offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense..."

questions.question: How many cities were given to the Levites in total?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21 gives the total as 48. 1 Chronicles 6 lists them but doesn't sum them up in one verse, but context matches the Levitical cities list.

questions.question: Which city was given to the sons of Aaron as a city of refuge?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:57 (ESV): "To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron..."

questions.question: Who stood on the left hand of Heman the singer?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:44 (ESV): "On the left hand were their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi..."

questions.question: Who was the father of Zadok?
Who went into exile when the Lord carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:15 (ESV): "And Jehozadak went into exile when the LORD carried... Judah and Jerusalem..."

questions.question: From which tribe was Ramoth in Gilead given?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:80 (ESV): "And out of the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with its pasturelands..."

questions.question: Which son of Samuel is named as the firstborn?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:28 (ESV): "The sons of Samuel: Joel his firstborn, the second Abijah."

questions.question: Who was the father of Asaph?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:39 (ESV): "and his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, namely, Asaph the son of Berechiah..."

key_verse_text: But Aaron and his sons made offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense for all the work of the Most Holy Place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
